name: Swiper-like loop carousel state (useLoopCarousel)
notes: Renders clones|real|clones; snaps back without transition after crossing into clones.
Drag: threshold px (5 default, 10 highlight), 45deg touch angle, short swipe <300ms always advances, long swipe advances past 0.5 of a step, release transition = 800ms ease, preventClicks after drag.
